subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: How should strict visible-text sanitization handle an unclosed `<think>` block when the original text also contains a `<final>` opener?
rationale: The current fallback can recover an answer but may expose hidden reasoning; changing it affects shared delivery semantics across providers and channels, so maintainer security intent is needed before automation changes behavior.

options.title: Recover only explicit final body
options.body: Parse the final boundary before stripping markers, return only the `<final>` body when it is code-aware and valid, and fail closed for unclosed hidden tails without a final boundary.

options.title: Fail closed on unclosed thinking
options.body: Drop all text after an unclosed strict-mode reasoning opener unless a separate stream/parser path has already classified it as visible final text.

options.title: Keep current recovery fallback
options.body: Preserve the current answer-recovery behavior and accept the risk that malformed tagged text can expose hidden reasoning.

recommendation.title: Recover only explicit final body
recommendation.body: Parse the final boundary before stripping markers, return only the `<final>` body when it is code-aware and valid, and fail closed for unclosed hidden tails without a final boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest shared sanitizer and streamed reasoning-tag history in the sampled evidence.
